messages:
lee: Quick sync 14 Quasar wants a 3-month Dedicated POC: 3x A100 baseline with an optional 3-day H100 sprint. They asked for: (1) 33% off month 1, (2) unused H100 hours convertible to credit if they sign a 12m commit, (3) no surge multiplier during the 3-day sprint. Need deal-desk + finance.
carla: Context: Quasar is evaluation-heavy but likely to buy if H100 perf is good. Procurement needs predictable POC spend.
mohit: Solutions: can region-lock and tag jobs. Recommend capping H100-hours to limit exposure and require 24h canary.
finance-bot: Reminder: discounts >30% need deal-desk approval. Conversion credits ok if non-refundable and timeboxed. Please include expected GPU-hours and model family.
deal-desk-bot: @channel Please open ticket: /deal-desk new --customer Quasar --commit "3x A100 90d" --burst "up to 3x H100 for 3d" --discount "33% month1" --conversion-credit "max 150 H100-hours" --surcharge-waive yes
lee: Proposed guardrails: conversion credit cap 150 H100-hours, expires 60 days after POC, applies only if a 12m commit executed within 60 days. No cash refunds; credit applied to first invoice.
mohit: Draft terms to paste:
```
- Baseline: 3x A100 reserved for 90 days.
- Burst: up to 3x H100 for a single 3-day sprint during POC.
- Discount: 33% credit applied to month 1 invoice for baseline commit only.
- Conversion Credit: Unused H100 hours up to 150 H100-hours convertible to account credit applied to first invoice of a subsequent 12-month Dedicated commitment executed within 60 days of POC completion. No cash refunds.
- Surge Multiplier: Waived for the 3-day sprint only.
- Autoscale/Canary: 24h canary required; region-locked to us-east-1.
- Billing: burst consumption exceeding 150 H100-hours billed at standard burst rate.
```
carla: Finance note: I can approve up to 31% discount with finance lead; full 33% needs deal-desk + revenue ops. Also need estimate of token throughput to finalize ARR impact.
lee: I'll file the ticket with these terms and request the 33% exception. Tagging @carla @mohit.
deal-desk-bot reaction: :white_check_mark: 
mohit: I'll prep a brief canary runbook and list of metrics (p95/p99, GPU mem, queue length). Coordinate with eng-run for scheduling.
carla: Once deal-desk signs off we'll loop in legal to finalize conversion-credit wording and transferability (prefer non-transferable).
lee: Filed: /deal-desk/1867009876  includes PSR and expected GPU-hours. Keeping thread here for updates. :thumbsup:
